title: 第25章 地狱级任务第26章 白猿
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: 七百二十道窍穴！
这已经超出了秦易对炼脉境的认知。
能全部打通三百六十道窍穴，也是极其罕见的，如果他能打通七百二十道窍穴呢？
是否会创造历史？
呼！
秦易深吸一口气，揉了揉太阳穴，感觉自己要走的路还很长。
不过所幸，有噬神塔在。
吱吱吱！
几天没见，小金又变大了很多，但是随着它的成长，食量越来越大，已经把秦易给吃空了。
它在跟秦易诉苦。
秦易皱眉，要想办法给小金弄点吃的啊。
“据我所知，它现在处于成长的关键时期，需要集齐庞大的能量，但是……”塔灵突然道：“如果能得到元丹境妖兽的内丹的话，绝对可以让它彻底蜕变。”
秦易苦笑。
他现在虽然在炼脉境中很强，但是对上元丹境，毫无还手之力啊。
而且，同境界下妖兽的实力，远高于人类强者。
“你让我去杀元丹境妖兽啊？”秦易问道。
塔灵道：“现在肯定不行，你要尽快打通所有窍穴。”
噔噔噔！
就在这时，有急促的敲门声传来。
秦易回归现实，赫然发现，来人居然是七长老。
“你已经获得了进入剑林的资格，不过还需要等十天时间。”七长老将这则消息告诉了秦易。
“多谢七长老。”秦易抱拳道谢。
七长老道：“这段时间，你好好修炼，争取打通更多的窍穴，如果你需要灵石的话，可以去任务殿接取一些简单的任务。”
说完，他还强调，千万不要接取难度系数高的任务。
待得七长老离开后，正好小胖回来了。
他告诉秦易，任务殿今天新发放出了一批任务，其中地狱级的任务，居然有三个，所有弟子都在议论。
“地狱级？”
秦易神色微动，他现在的修为已经停滞，需要一个契机，也就是剑林开启，才有希望继续打通更多的窍穴。
而小金已经迫不及待的需要庞大的能量来成长。
“带我去任务殿看看。”秦易说道。
小胖带着秦易，很快便来到了任务殿。
此时的任务殿门口，汇聚了无数外门弟子。
大部分外门弟子，看到秦易后，纷纷后退，眼眸中充满了恐惧之意。
开什么玩笑。
武斗场十连胜，那可是非常有含金量的。
content_en:
Seven hundred and twenty acupoints!
This has gone beyond Qin Yi's understanding of the Pulse Refining Realm.
It is extremely rare to be able to open all 360 acupoints. What if he can open 720 acupoints?
Will history be made?
call!
Qin Yi took a deep breath and rubbed his temples, feeling that he still had a long way to go.
Fortunately, there is the God-Eating Tower.
Squeak!
After not seeing each other for a few days, Xiao Jin has grown a lot bigger, but as it grows, its appetite becomes larger and larger, and it has already eaten up Qin Yi.
It was complaining to Qin Yi.
Qin Yi frowned and wanted to find a way to get Xiaojin something to eat.
"As far as I know, it is now in a critical period of growth and needs to gather huge amounts of energy, but..." Ta Ling suddenly said: "If we can get the inner elixir of the Yuan Dan realm monster, we can definitely transform it completely."
Qin Yi smiled bitterly.
Although he is very strong in the Pulse Refining Realm now, he has no power to fight back against the Yuan Dan Realm.
Moreover, the strength of monster beasts in the same realm is much higher than that of strong humans.
"You want me to kill Yuandan realm monsters?" Qin Yi asked.
Ta Ling said: "It's definitely not possible now. You have to open all the acupoints as soon as possible."
Thump thump thump!
At this moment, there was a rapid knock on the door.
Qin Yi returned to reality and suddenly discovered that the person who came was actually the Seventh Elder.
"You have obtained the qualification to enter the Sword Forest, but you still need to wait ten days." The seventh elder told Qin Yi the news.
"Thank you, Seventh Elder." Qin Yi cupped his fists and thanked him.
The Seventh Elder said: "During this period, you should practice hard and try to open more acupoints. If you need spiritual stones, you can go to the Mission Hall to accept some simple tasks."
After that, he also emphasized that you should never take on tasks with high difficulty.
After the seventh elder left, Xiaopang happened to come back.
He told Qin Yi that the Mission Hall had issued a new batch of missions today, among which there were actually three hell-level missions, and all the disciples were talking about them.
"Hell level?"
Qin Yi's expression moved slightly. His current cultivation level has stagnated. He needs an opportunity, that is, the opening of the sword forest, before he can hope to continue to open more acupoints.
And Xiao Jin can't wait to need huge energy to grow.
"Take me to the mission hall." Qin Yi said.
Xiaopang took Qin Yi and soon arrived at the mission hall.
At this time, countless outer disciples gathered at the entrance of the mission hall.
Most of the outer disciples backed away after seeing Qin Yi, their eyes filled with fear.
What a joke.
Ten consecutive victories in the martial arts arena are very valuable.
